usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks, and “New Task Created in Project” can start a draft in Contentstack.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Content Entry” in Contentstack
bestTemplate.why: Each task in a content project opens a matching entry in Contentstack, ready to write and publish.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist is polling, so the entry appears after a scheduled check.
